description: Haarlemmerdijk / Haarlemmerstraat narrow cornice shop houses (lijstgevels of the 18th-19th c.): 3.8-7.6 m fronts of red-brown brick, a tall shop ground storey to about 4.7 m and two or three upper storeys of white-framed T-windows, under a plain white cornice at 10-13.5 m, sometimes one small dormer over the middle

match.note: Haarlemmerdijk 6-18 (2022-12-15 strip): fascia top 4.7 m, rows 5.7-7.6 / 8.2-9.7 m, white cornice 10.0-11.8 m; a front with a dormer reads rise 1.0-1.5 m. Dormer rise capped at 1.8 m where the gable house's crowns start. crownStrict off: on the narrow dijk the fused strip carries ghost gables of the neighbours (2022-12-15), so the skyline crown is a score, and reviewer crown pins decide. crownMatch off and eavesM [9.6, 12.0] (a 3.6 m pitch: three storeys at 9.8-11.6 m, four at 12.4-14.4 m, the tall shop ground counted in): every placed pand on these faces carries a reviewer type and crown pin, and eaves pins from the 1 m grid

dormer.note: Haarlemmerdijk 6 (176172), 18 (167817): one white dormer over the middle

door-left.note: residential ground: house door on the left axis; shops come per pand from BAG/OSM (autoShopfront)

roof.evidence: Haarlemmerdijk 6, 33, 35A (2022-12-15 strips): sky stands directly over the cornice and the dormer, no roof face over the cornice; the 3DBAG front attic at 30 deg drew a red band the strips never show. Canal-house saddles run front to back (hip front); pitch 35 deg keeps the hipped face over the cornice to about 1.4 m on a 4-5 m front (50 deg drew a 2.7 m red triangle the strips never show)

rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: a shop (BAG/OSM) or a house door and window | upper: 2 or 3
rhythm.groundFloor: a tall shop ground 4.4-4.9 m to the fascia top on the dijk and straat
rhythm.roofline: a plain white cornice, sometimes one dormer
schemaLimits: the cornice frieze and consoles are a plain slab
